description: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive 3-button controller as exposed by libretro / genesis_plus_gx. 8 buttons: d-pad, three face buttons (A west, B south, C east), Start. No shoulders, no Select on a 3-button pad. Source for the libretro id mapping: genesis_plus_gx input descriptor (A=Y(1), B=B(0), C=A(8)).
